name: Design
question: Start with people.
description: Understand user needs, define the problem, identify stakeholders and set clear requirements.

name: Develop
question: Build and validate.
description: Work with data and models, implement the solution, then test and validate it against the requirements.

name: Communicate
question: Make the impact clear.
description: Explain the results and their impact through clear technical and scientific communication.

name: Manage
question: Support every stage.
description: Plan the project, coordinate people and resources, track key performance indicators (KPIs) and manage risks across Design, Develop and Communicate.
